note: The one order data of routeConnector (companion-connector-route.mjs, and every port of it: the desktop and the phone read the same connector-route-vectors.json). The ladder is read from the rungs here, never written per service. Order inside a rung: less power first (files and scripts, then a signed-in browser, then the whole screen; on the phone the standard system screens, then a routine the person made, then a web page driven inside the app). altMax: one better road that is one step away plus one lower road that works now; the third is not told. whyOrder: the order in which a blocked reason is told when no road is left (a reason not in the list is told as 'unavailable'). If the owner wants another order, only this file changes.
